name: Growth corner
rule: high growth, low margin: g at or above the 75th percentile, m below the 25th

name: Balanced upper quartile
rule: score between the 75th and 95th percentiles, g and m both at or above the median

name: Mature cash generator
rule: g below the median, m at or above the 75th percentile

name: Sub-40 grower
rule: g between the median and the 75th percentile, m below the median

name: Stalled
rule: g and m both below the median

name: Near-frontier elite
rule: score at or above the 95th percentile (Paper 1's calibration anchor)

name: Acquisition-driven compounder
rule: a serial acquirer: Bending Spoons, reported against organic growth
